title: "Pilot undergoing prebreathing" – U-2 pilot in helmet with oxygen setup (Chapter 2, p. 65)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a U-2 pilot in a pressure helmet reclining in a chair and reading while connected to an oxygen supply, with an attendant and gas cylinders in the background. Captioned "Pilot undergoing prebreathing." The text describes provisions for drinking water and squeezable foods through the face mask and notes that pilots also received a suicide pill.
